scope: Conservative short standalone prose salvage from prior mechanically accepted FineWeb only. No text rewriting. Does not attempt to salvage all good long/list/medical/commercial documents.

rules.commercial_or_signup: \b(?:buy|purchase|shop|sale|discount|customers?|clients?|book now|booking|registration|register|subscribe|contact us|sign up|refund|shipping|our services|our products|our team|free trial|get in touch|order now|click|download|donate|pricing|price|costs?|fees?|tickets?)\b|[$€₹£]
rules.exercise_or_missing_media: \b(?:antonyms?|synonyms?|fill in the blank|multiple choice|answer key|worksheet|watch (?:the|this)|video|pictured|image above|image below|photo above|photo below|read more|learn more|see below|see above|figure \d|table \d)\b
rules.boilerplate: \b(?:all rights reserved|privacy|cookies|terms and conditions|copyright|leave a reply|posted by|related articles|share this|follow us|newsletter|posted on)\b

sampling: Fresh deterministic pseudorandom document sample of 200 train records after freezing filters; exclude every prior FineWeb sample family from salvage pool. Equal selection opportunity per eligible train document; not token-weighted.
early_rejection: Reject once >10 total failures or >4 major failures. Never early accept. No tuning on validation sample without new holdout.
failure_action: Reject source slice, retain only individually reviewed passing records as explicitly limited salvage; report separately.
pass_action: Admit slice excluding observed failed families. Report sample uncertainty and exact manifest counts, not certified population quality.
